title: 3 children, 1 teacher dead after shooting at Oregon elementary school, police say
summary: A shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, left multiple people dead on Thursday, the local police chief said during a Thursday news conference.

image.caption: Police tape is seen placed outside Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, on Thursday. (Joe Kline/The Associated Press)

blocks.text: A shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, left multiple people dead on Thursday, the local police chief said during a Thursday news conference.
Shooting occurred at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Ore., on Thursday afternoon
Bend police Chief Mike Krantz said three children and a teacher were killed.
The suspected gunman was also dead.
Police are seen outside the school on Thursday. (Rob Kerr/Reuters)
